Title: Missing getAnalysisRuns Apex query endpoint
Description: DAGraphController lacks an @AuraEnabled method to query historical analysis runs for a project.
Proposed_Resolution: Add getAnalysisRuns(Id projectId) WITH USER_MODE to DAGraphController.cls.

Title: Live Salesforce Org verification deferred
Description: All current verification runs against offline Node.js mocks. Live deployment to scratch org is deferred.
Proposed_Resolution: Maintain strict offline mocks; provision scratch org validation pass prior to production packaging.

Title: Dual-Snapshot Canvas Memory Overhead in Wave 8
Description: Rendering two full Cytoscape instances simultaneously could exceed browser memory limits for large graphs.
Proposed_Resolution: Implement diff engine to render single Cytoscape canvas with delta styling (green/red) rather than two canvases.

Title: Command Palette & Global Search not represented in roadmap
Description: Keyboard shortcut modal and command palette (useCommandPalette) are omitted from Waves 5-9.
Proposed_Resolution: Catalog as auxiliary UX feature; evaluate for inclusion in post-Wave 9 hardening.

Title: CLI to Apex Ingestion Automation
Description: Ingestion service requires HTTP POST multipart/chunked calls from CI/CD pipeline.
Proposed_Resolution: Retain scripts/export-explorer.cjs as external adapter script for ingestion orchestration.
